=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:543-574 (also 1216, 1592-1635; same defect in .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The closing `)` is stripped only in the segment that opened the subshell, so in `(cd repo && git push)` the subcommand stays `push)` and is not in GUARDED_SUBCOMMANDS.
  WHY: The merged-PR guard skips such pushes and commits. Severity disagreement: MAJOR from most reviewers, security finding from gemini with no severity stated.
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:939-963 (same defect in .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `_cd_command_words` skips `builtin`/`command` but not `-p`, so `command -p cd DIR` is not recognized as a cd.
  WHY: The following push is judged against the session checkout instead of DIR and can pass unchecked.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:1013-1020, 1090-1104, 1151-1157 (same defect in workflow-templates copy; `_changes_cd_resolution` at 968-1004) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: A `CDPATH=...` assignment attached to a shell wrapper (`CDPATH=/srv bash -c 'cd repo && git push ...'`) is consumed as a leading assignment but never sets or forwards `shell_cdpath_set`/`_inherited_cdpath_set`.
  WHY: The inner `cd repo` resolves against the session checkout instead of `/srv/repo`, so the push is checked in the wrong repository. Severity disagreement: sonnet-5_5 rated it NIT (a prompt still appears), the others MAJOR.
- tests/test_prepush_affected_tests.py:701-709 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `test_hook_falls_back_for_a_push_the_guard_does_not_parse` now uses `(cd . && git push)`, and the reviewers disagree on whether it exercises the fallback.
  WHY: sonnet-5_5 says it passes only because of the cross-segment bug and will break once that is fixed. minimax says the guard already parses it, so the fallback is not exercised. z-ai_glm-5_3-flash says it is sound. Severity is NIT.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:818-842, 940 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: Working directory tracking appears inconsistent across nested shell constructs and recursive `wrapped_bodies` calls.
  WHY: Git commands may be checked in the wrong repository or branch context. No severity was stated.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: PR table says a glued subshell, `(git push origin x)`, `(cd repo && git commit …)`, goes from "not seen" to "parsed and guarded".
  expected_change_site: `_command_after_control_prefix` plus the segment loops in `_guarded_git_invocations` / `git_subcommands` in both hook copies, and tests/test_pr_merge_status_guard.py
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The closing `)` is handled only when the same segment opened the subshell, the #6038 tests cover only single-segment subshells, and no test has `(` and `)` in different segments.
- requirement: PR table says a `cd` whose destination depends on a `CDPATH` set in the same command moves from "guarded in the wrong repo" to "destination treated as unverified, so it asks".
  expected_change_site: `_changes_cd_resolution` and the leading-assignment handling / `_inherited_cdpath_set` forwarding in `_guarded_git_invocations` (both hook copies)
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  EVIDENCE: `CDPATH=/srv bash -c 'cd repo && git push …'` yields `sets_cdpath=False` because `bash` is not an assignment, and `test_cdpath_set_before_a_shell_wrapper_reaches_its_cd` covers only the `export CDPATH=/srv;` form.
- requirement: Any cd that changes the resolved directory is treated as an unverified destination ("see git behind wrapper prefixes, subshells and CDPATH").
  expected_change_site: `_cd_command_words` in both copies of pr_merge_status_guard.py (lines 949-963)
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The loop skips only bare `command`/`builtin`, so `command -p cd DIR && git push` is not recognized. No test covers it.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py (same code in .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py):543-573, 1625-1635 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The closing `)` is removed only from a segment that also opened the subshell, so `(cd repo && git push)` yields `push)`.
  WHY: `push)` is not in GUARDED_SUBCOMMANDS, so pushes and commits in this form skip the merged-PR check, contrary to the PR table.
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:939-954 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `_cd_command_words` skips `command` but not `-p`, so `command -p cd DIR` is not recognized.
  WHY: The push is judged in the session checkout and can pass unchecked. This also disagrees with `_TRANSPARENT_COMMAND_PREFIXES`, which accepts `-p`.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:1090-1104, 1151-1157 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `CDPATH=...` attached to a shell wrapper is not added to `shell_cdpath_set` or passed as `_inherited_cdpath_set`.
  WHY: The inner cd is resolved against the starting checkout and prompts "could not resolve git command directory"; the case is narrow.
- tests/test_prepush_affected_tests.py (`test_hook_falls_back_for_a_push_the_guard_does_not_parse`) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The test passes only because of the cross-segment subshell bug.
  WHY: Fixing the bug will break the test.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: PR table says `(git push origin x)`, `(cd repo && git commit …)` are "parsed and guarded".
  Expected change site: `_command_after_control_prefix`, the segment loops in `git_subcommands` and `_guarded_git_invocations`, and tests/test_pr_merge_status_guard.py
  Evidence of absence: Only single-segment subshells are handled and tested, and the previous autofix run deferred this. | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS: Track an open-subshell counter across segments, or strip one trailing `)` when an earlier segment has an unclosed `(`. Add a `(cd x && git push)` test and update the prepush fallback test. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 4
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:543-574 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The closing `)` stripping is segment-bound and fails for multi-segment subshells.
  WHY: `(cd repo && git push)` is parsed as `push)`, which bypasses the merged-PR guard.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:949-963 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `_cd_command_words` does not handle `command -p`.
  WHY: The working directory is not updated, so the push is checked against the original checkout.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:1015-1020, 1090-1104, 1151-1157 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `CDPATH` assignments in wrapped shell commands are not forwarded to `shell_cdpath_set` or `_inherited_cdpath_set`.
  WHY: Relative paths resolve against the starting checkout, so guard protections can be bypassed.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:818-842, 940 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Working directory tracking appears inconsistent across nested shell constructs and recursive `wrapped_bodies` calls.
  WHY: Git commands may be checked in the wrong repository or branch context.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: `(git push origin x)`, `(cd repo && git commit …)` should be parsed and guarded.
  Expected change site: .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py (`_command_after_control_prefix`, `_guarded_git_invocations`) and tests/test_pr_merge_status_guard.py
  Evidence of absence: The logic and tests cover only single-segment subshells, so `(cd repo && git push)` is not guarded. | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=4
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

  PROBLEM: `test_hook_falls_back_for_a_push_the_guard_does_not_parse` now uses `(cd . && git push)`, which minimax says the guard parses, so the fallback is not exercised.
  WHY: The `ask` assertion passes for unrelated reasons, so the test name and comment misdescribe it and mask coverage gaps.

- TASK_GAP: Requirement: PR table row "CDPATH=… cd x && git push ... destination treated as unverified, so it asks", extended to the wrapper form `CDPATH=/srv bash -c '...'`.
  Expected change site: `_changes_cd_resolution` in both hook copies (985-1004)
  Evidence of absence: `_changes_cd_resolution` returns `sets_cdpath=False` for `["CDPATH=/srv", "bash", "-c", ...]`. The existing test covers only the `export CDPATH=/srv;` form. | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
